title: IMU Studio
summary: 9-DoF 3D Cube, Tap X-Ray, BCG/Tremor, Magic Wand, Shaper, FFT & 6-Model ML
description: IMU Studio turns CardputerZero's BMI270 + BMM150 9-DoF sensors into an engineering & EDC lab: Smart Auto-Baseline, 8 Guided Missions, Madgwick Quaternion 3D Horizon/Cube, 3D Tilt-Compensated Compass, Magnetic Metal/Stud Finder, 100 Hz Vibration FFT & ISO 10816 Grade A-F, Klipper/K1C Dual-Axis X+Y Input Shaper, STA/LTA Tamper Guard, Black-Box Replay, Wall/Tank Tap X-Ray (IMUTapNet-1D), Non-Medical BCG Pulse/Tremor (IMUBioNet-1D), 3D Air Magic Wand (IMUGestureNet-1D), 6 embedded INT8 models (32.6 KiB, 0 allocs), and opt-in 30-tool MCP.
